dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, you haven't eaten anything. Are you still stressed about work?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈhævənt ˈiːtən ˈɛniθɪŋ. ər juː ˈstɪl ˈstrɛst əˈbaʊt ˈwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. I can't sleep well, and I've had headaches all week.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. aɪ ˈkænt ˈsliːp ˈwɛl, ənd aɪv ˈhæd ˈhɛdeɪks ˈɔːl ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's how stress starts. If you don't deal with it, it can lead to serious health problems.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈhaʊ ˈstrɛs ˈstɑːrts. ɪf juː ˈdoʊnt ˈdiːl wɪð ɪt, ɪt kən ˈliːd tə ˈsɪriəs ˈhɛlθ ˈprɑːbləmz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Stress causes physical problems, like headaches and stomach pain. It can cause anxiety, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈstrɛs ˈkɔːzɪz ˈfɪzɪkəl ˈprɑːbləmz, ˈlaɪk ˈhɛdeɪks ənd ˈstʌmək ˈpeɪn. ɪt kən ˈkɔːz æŋˈzaɪəti, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think I have a bit of anxiety. I worry about work all the time.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈbɪt əv æŋˈzaɪəti. aɪ ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ˈwɜːrk ˈɔːl ðə ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And too much stress for too long can result in burnout. That happened to my sister.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ ˈstrɛs fər ˈtuː ˈlɔːŋ kən rɪˈzʌlt ɪn ˈbɜːrnaʊt. ðæt ˈhæpənd tə maɪ ˈsɪstər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She worked twelve hours a day for a year. In the end, she was so tired that she had to quit.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈwɜːrkt ˈtwɛlv ˈaʊərz ə ˈdeɪ fər ə ˈjɪr. ɪn ði ˈɛnd, ʃiː wʌz soʊ ˈtaɪərd ðæt ʃiː ˈhæd tə ˈkwɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible. I don't want that to happen to me.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt ðæt tə ˈhæpən tə miː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then let's go for a walk after lunch. Fresh air helps!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ fər ə ˈwɔːk ˈæftər ˈlʌntʃ. ˈfrɛʃ ˈɛr ˈhɛlps!
